component.name: 7-Zip GUI
component.summary: Compress and extract archives with the 7-Zip file manager

description.p: 7-Zip GUI provides the Windows 7-Zip file manager for creating, browsing and extracting archives. It supports 7z, ZIP and many other formats, including password-protected archives.

This community package downloads the official Windows x64 installer at install time. On first launch, Cellar runs the installer in a private Wine prefix. Install the shared Wine dependency with flatpak install flathub org.winehq.Wine//stable-26.08.
The file manager can access your home directory to work with archives. Windows shell integration does not integrate with your Linux file manager.
The interface follows your desktop scale by default. If the text or controls are too small, choose a larger size. Restart 7-Zip after changing the setting.

ul.li: Example for larger text and controls: flatpak run --command=cellar io.github.ip7z.SevenZipGUI config dpi=168
Restore automatic scaling: flatpak run --command=cellar io.github.ip7z.SevenZipGUI config dpi=auto
